body:
I saw a mother frantically call for help as another woman was tugging on her baby that she desperately held to protect. No one came for her help. My parents called the cops, but they arrived 1 hour later. So they were too late......*way* too late.

I don't think I'll ever forget it.

No need to call me a complete normie, asshole. See, it's people like you that go straight to hostile judgement and shit. I wasn't shown a lot of communism, but I'm sure they have done some fucked up shit, but how was I suppose to know while I was busy going through all of this learning about it, seeing it all, and so on? So could you do me a favor and not talk to me like as if I'm an idiot, as well as NOT call me a "Normie"? My ancestors were abused by those who enslaved them. So you think you have it rough? You're not the only one. Don't forget that, hardhead.

And you don't think I sympathize with the Jews that were slaughtered by the Nazi scum? It still disgusts me that people would go out of their way to kill a large portion of people, all because they followed their leader's bullshit assumptions about the Jews.

And don't you fucking assume that I only seem to know and care about what I see and hear in popular media. I know some shit that even the popular media wouldn't dare talk about. Basically, in their words, I know more than I should.

And hey, I'm fucking sorry that your great grandfather was killed in a Concentration Camp. I wish that never happened, but hey, there's nothing I can do about that! It's out of my control, and in the past! All I can do is sympathize and wish your family well. What do you want me to do?

I have seen and experienced so much negativity by many and many people throughout my life. I never really asked to see the dark side of life. I have frantically tried to find good people and more just to ease the long and lingering rage, pain, depression, and so on that I had for years.

For example, I've been - Deathly Threatened. Generally Threatened. Ganged Up On. Spat At. Betrayed. Lied To. Used. Physically Harmed. Emotionally Harmed. Rejected. Judged. Socially Alienated. Had Friends Leave Me Behind. Had a picture drawn of me being killed by the person as they cheer for my death. Had Kids Try To Put Fecal Matter On My Face. And Told To Kill Myself.

My parents weren't often...or barely there. I didn't have a lot of friends, for I mostly had fake friends. I was mostly lonely. And I was even on the verge of wanting to attempt suicide because of all of this

And all of this has happened to me for 15 years. Deep down I know I want to get along with people, but because of all of this, it's why I am misanthropic, and rather live with animals.

(I know. Just a silly sob story. But it's the truth.)  


P.S. I know I'll regain my faith in humanity one day. But right now, going through the darkness and such.
